baseline_report: After 8 cycles of nivolumab, the patient developed pruritic 1-2 mm shiny papules spreading from the upper limbs to the body. Skin biopsy showed vacuolar interface dermatitis with lymphohistiocytic infiltrate and pigment incontinence, with no malignant cells; both pathologist and laboratory physician interpreted this as consistent with immune-related skin toxicity. The temporal relationship with nivolumab, pruritic papules/plaques, and biopsy findings strongly support this diagnosis (confidence 0.88). Lung cancer skin metastasis is very unlikely because biopsy lacks malignant cells and the lesions are atypical; non-neoplastic papular rash is also less likely given the biopsy pattern and temporal link. Lack of immunohistochemistry leaves slight uncertainty but does not change the conclusion. The frontier is sufficiently refined.
